content.description:
What Cognite is Relentless to Achieve

Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. Our Moonshot is bold: unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works.

The Solution Architect owns data architecture and technical excellence for a customer's first Cognite project, the Quick Start. The role designs the end-to-end solution, turns use cases into designs the pod can build, sets the technical bar, and lays the foundation for expansion.

Every day looks different. As a Deployment Strategist, here's what you can expect:

Design the foundation a customer's first project stands on: an end-to-end solution that fits their ecosystem and is built to scale into the next phase.

Get ahead of the blockers: find the system owners and access prerequisites early, so data extraction is not the thing that slips.

Set the technical bar for the pod: define standards and review the work of Solution Engineers and Data Engineers so the first project lands well.

Be the trusted technical voice on site: advise customer teams and partners on Cognite Data Fusion, beside the pod lead, Account Executive, and Field Engineer.

Plot the path to expansion: map the follow-on use cases your architecture makes possible, and feed what you learn back to Product.

The Ownership You Will Hold

This role goes beyond drawing diagrams. You'll own data architecture and technical excellence for a customer's first Cognite project, combining consulting, architecture, and hands-on delivery in a cross-functional pod.

Design the end-to-end solution and turn business use cases into designs the pod can build against, fitting the customer's target architecture and scaling into expansion.

Set technical standards and review work from Solution Engineers and Data Engineers.

Ensure data is efficiently modelled and contextualised in Cognite Data Fusion (graph and relational), and set honest expectations on what contextualisation can and cannot achieve.

Design robust integrations using Cognite connectors, SQL, Python or Java, and REST APIs, and plan data onboarding with system owners and prerequisites identified early.

Make sure solution criteria are met: CI/CD, logging, security, and clearly defined operational responsibility and support agreements.

Guide customer teams through Cognite Data Fusion architecture and administration to remove configuration bottlenecks.

Work with the Field Engineer and Account Executive on the technical roadmap for follow-on use cases, and with Product on productised onboarding.

The Impact You Bring

Must have

Architecture track record: 5+ years as an application, data, solution, or enterprise architect, leading data and analytics implementations. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Data and analytics depth: data modelling and infrastructure experience, including data warehousing or big data architectures, SQL, and BI tools such as Power BI.

Cloud and operations: public cloud experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure) including network security and identity, plus Git, CI/CD, monitoring, logging, and change control.

Consulting credibility: you negotiate requirements with customers and colleagues with confidence, including on site, and can travel up to 80%.

Hands-on when it matters: you will write code on advanced topics when the pod needs it.

Strong plus

Industrial instinct: 2+ years in oil and gas, manufacturing, or pharmaceuticals, or experience with Cognite Data Fusion or a comparable industrial data platform.

Value Delivery is building a strategic team focused on converting customers from land to expand. Join us!

A snapshot of our many perks and benefits as a Cogniter

* Competitive compensation

* 401(k) with employer matching

* Competitive health, dental, vision & disability coverages for employees and all dependents

* Unlimited PTO

* Paid Parental Leave Program

* Employee Referral Program

Why Cognite

You will work at the forefront of Industrial AI, partnering with some of the world's leading industrial organisations to solve problems that actually matter at scale — not hypothetical ones. You'll join a collaborative, fast-moving environment where curiosity and ownership are the norm, not the exception. If you want delivery work you can point to and be proud of, we'd love to hear from you.

Equal Opportunity

Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.
